newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to give Haneda slots to small airlines - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan to give Haneda slots to small airlines - paper.

text.p: The Ministry of Transport plans to give small airlines and new carriers priority when it allocates new slots at Tokyo's Haneda airport, which is mostly used for domestic flights, in an effort to promote competition in the industry, a newspaper said on Wednesday.
Construction of a new runway at the airport is expected to be completed next March, the economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
After the runway's opening, the airport will be able to handle 25 more daily departures and a similar number of arrivals, the paper said.
The ministry plans to give about 10 departure and arrival slots each to small airlines and new carriers, the paper said.
The ministry was not immediately available for comment.
Currently, the airport handles a combined 570 departures and arrivals a day.
